sacred-profane-love.text: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
sacred-profane-love.full: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

venus-and-mars.text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
venus-and-mars.full: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

allegory-venus-cupid.text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
allegory-venus-cupid.full: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

primavera.text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
primavera.full: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

venus-of-urbino.text: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
venus-of-urbino.full: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.

the-cyclops.text: I will guide thee with mine eye.
the-cyclops.full: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

the-caress.text: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
the-caress.full: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

jupiter-and-semele.text: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
jupiter-and-semele.full: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

kiss-of-the-sphinx.text: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
kiss-of-the-sphinx.full: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

lovers-whirlwind.text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
lovers-whirlwind.full: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

beata-beatrix.text: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
beata-beatrix.full: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

mars-venus-cupid.text: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
mars-venus-cupid.full: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

venus-disarming-cupid.text: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
venus-disarming-cupid.full: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

saskia.text: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
saskia.full: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

paolo-francesca.text: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
paolo-francesca.full: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

the-kiss-rodin.text: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
the-kiss-rodin.full: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

eternal-springtime.text: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
eternal-springtime.full: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

psyche-revived.text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
psyche-revived.full: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

the-waltz.text: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
the-waltz.full: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

kiss-klimt.text: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
kiss-klimt.full: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

liebe-klimt.text: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
liebe-klimt.full: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.

madonna-munch.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
madonna-munch.full: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

kiss-munch.text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
kiss-munch.full: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

umarmung-schiele.text: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
umarmung-schiele.full: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

dance-of-life.text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
dance-of-life.full: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

birth-of-venus.text: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
birth-of-venus.full: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

venus-with-mirror.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
venus-with-mirror.full: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

garden-of-love.text: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
garden-of-love.full: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

embarkation-cythera.text: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
embarkation-cythera.full: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

mars-venus-veronese.text: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
mars-venus-veronese.full: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

ophelia-redon.text: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
ophelia-redon.full: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

the-apparition.text: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
the-apparition.full: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

love-among-ruins.text: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
love-among-ruins.full: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

the-beloved.text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
the-beloved.full: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

venus-cupid-niche.text: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
venus-cupid-niche.full: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

ill-assorted-couple.text: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
ill-assorted-couple.full: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

jupiter-antiope.text: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
jupiter-antiope.full: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

liebespaar-klimt.text: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
liebespaar-klimt.full: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

liebespaar-schiele.text: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
liebespaar-schiele.full: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

three-graces-canova.text: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
three-graces-canova.full: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

amor-psyche-canova.text: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
amor-psyche-canova.full: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

eros-stringing-bow.text: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
eros-stringing-bow.full: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

danae-klimt.text: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
danae-klimt.full: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

water-serpents.text: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
water-serpents.full: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

vampire-munch.text: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
vampire-munch.full: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

ashes-munch.text: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
ashes-munch.full: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
